description: IEEE 754 totalOrder on two binary32 or binary64 values. Negative zero is below positive zero. Negative NaNs are below minus infinity and positive NaNs are above plus infinity. A larger NaN payload is farther from zero. sameBits is true only when every bit matches. form bits reads both sides as hex; the default reads them as numbers rounded ties-to-even. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/float-order
